ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Código de Comercio arts. 19, 110 and 253; Ley 2010 de 2019 art. 92 (UBO substantive rule); Decreto 830 de 2021 and Resolución DIAN 164 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB); Ley 526 de 1999 and Decreto 1749 de 2000 (UIAF and AML/CFT framework); Circular Externa 100-000005 de 2021 de la Superintendencia de Sociedades (SARLAFT in the non-financial corporate sector); Ley 2195 de 2022 (PEP integrity and corruption-prevention protocols); FATF Recommendations 10, 22 and 24.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the UBO's country of residence (or a Colombian consulate abroad)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (apostille member states) OR Consular Legalization (non-member states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notarial or consular authority of the passport's origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or Chamber of Commerce of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (non-member states: full consular legalization chain through the Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Pre-incorporation negative-evidence screening of every direct and indirect UBO and of the designated legal representative against: OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists; UN Security Council consolidated sanctions (1267/1989, 1988, 1718, 2231); EU consolidated financial sanctions list; UK consolidated sanctions list; and Colombian official registries (UIAF list of money-laundering risk persons, SIC sanctions, Procuraduría/Contraloría disenfranchised and convicted public-officer registries under Ley 2195 de 2022). A signed non-PEP declaración jurada and lawful source-of-funds statement is mandatory; screening must be refreshed at least every 90 days while incorporation steps remain open. Once operational, any Swift wire or PayPal credit exceeding COP 25,000,000 (approx. USD 6,400) in a single operation triggers an ROS report to UIAF, and the S.A.S. must adopt a proportional SARLAFT manual subject to Superintendencia de Sociedades supervision.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – official portal www.rues.org.co; name pre-validation and reservation executed through the electronic counter of the competent local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá Sede Electrónica), issuing the Certificado de Homologación de Razón Social.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate style must be expressed in Spanish (Castilian) using Latin script; English terms of accepted international use are tolerated only as a secondary distinguishing element and must be pronounceable in Spanish; the name must end with the acronym 'S.A.S.'; only letters, numerals, the ampersand, hyphen and period are admissible; the full denomination must be distinguishable from existing registered trade names under the exact-homonymy rule (identical spelling, not phonetic similarity); all foreign-language constitutive and supporting documents require official translation by a Colombian traductor oficial prior to chamber registration.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Colombia (as a standalone denominative token; requires prior authorization of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
Gobierno Nacional (or any combination implying State agency status)
Banco (requires Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia license)
Seguros, Aseguradora, Compañía de Seguros (requires SFC license)
Cooperativa, Fondo de Empleados (requires Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria authorization)
Bolsa de Valores, Comisionista de Bolsa, Sociedad Fiduciaria (requires SFC authorization)
Nacional (when combined with official institutional names implying public entity status)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Certificado de Homologación de Razón Social is denied, the applicant may: (1) submit a fresh homologation request with a new distinguishing token (new RUES fee applies); (2) file a recurso de reposición before the deciding Cámara de Comercio within 10 business days of the negative certificate, per arts. 74–76 of Ley 1437 de 2011; (3) escalate through recurso de apelación to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; and (4) after final administrative adverse decision, seek judicial review before the Jurisdicción Contencioso-Administrativa. The reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30-day period by written petition filed before expiration; a rejected name remains blocked until the reservation window lapses unless the rejection is absolute.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for the corporate seat (domicilio social) only, provided the virtual or coworking address is physically verifiable within the chamber's address-validation layer and the operator accepts service of process and domiciliary notifications. Purely virtual infrastructure is not sufficient for the operating activity: zinc alloy die-casting and tampo printing require a separate physical industrial plant with municipal zoning approval (uso de suelo), environmental and fire-safety permits, and Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA) registration at the plant location. The DIAN RUT must reflect the operational establishment; therefore the company should maintain both a virtual registered office and a real industrial plant.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High; quantified at 65–75% probability of an unannounced on-site visit within the first 18 months of operation. Triggers include DIAN RUT verification campaigns, municipal ICA controllers, mandatory Cuerpo de Bomberos annual fire-safety inspection, regional environmental authority (CAR) inspection of metal-dust and wastewater controls, and SIC/chamber random verification visits for newly registered industrial companies.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime), Articles 1, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 20; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110 and 353-358 (merchant registration and corporate books); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (single-commerce-regulatory decree and simplified RUES filing); Decreto 019 de 2012 (anti-red-tape statutory deadlines).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) acting through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), in coordination with DIAN and the municipal treasury.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation deed and by-laws) filed in the Mercantile Registry via RUES; notarial protocolización is required only when real property is contributed (Ley 1258 de 2008, Article 5).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for the S.A.S. Subscribed shares must be fully paid within the by-law term, which may not exceed two (2) years (Ley 1258 de 2008, Article 9); contributions may be made in cash without a mandatory escrow account, or in kind with a valuation filed at constitution. At least one share must be subscribed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST ORGANIZATIONAL RESOLUTION OF THE SHAREHOLDERS OF THE SOCIEDAD POR ACCIONES SIMPLIFICADA (S.A.S.). 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION: The shareholders ratify the subscription and full payment of the capital stock as recorded in the share ledger. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE: The legal domicile is set at [avenida/street], Bogotá D.C., Colombia, as the venue for service of process and corporate correspondence. 3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: [Name] is appointed Manager and Legal Representative under Article 20 of Law 1258 of 2008; [Name] is appointed Alternate Officer. 4. DELEGATION: The Legal Representative is instructed to file the certificate of incorporation with the Chamber of Commerce, to complete DIAN/RUES registration, to apply for municipal and environmental licenses, and to open the corporate bank account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Homonimy Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Confecámaras electronic window through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES), www.rues.org.co, operated by the local Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES portal, open the 'homonimia' consultation, enter up to three proposed corporate names (e.g., 'MODELCAR DIE CAST COLOMBIA S.A.S.'), and obtain the name-availability approval, which is valid for ninety (90) calendar days. The certificate confirms that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered in the national Chamber of Commerce network.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name(s) with the S.A.S. denomination
Identification document of the incorporating party or its attorney-in-fact
Contact e-mail and mobile number of the subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is objected to by reason of similarity, the applicant may present a second alternative name in the same session or file a written reconsideration request before the Cámara de Comercio, which must be resolved within five (5) business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Incorporation Deed (Estatutos)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscribers directly; Notaría Pública exclusively when real property is contributed to the corporate capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Documento Privado de Constitución setting out corporate name, domicile (Bogotá D.C.), corporate purpose covering ISIC 3240 zinc-alloy die-casting and tampo printing of scale automotive replicas, capital structure, manager powers and governance rules under Ley 1258 de 2008. Signatures shall be certified before a notary or authorized electronically when the platform permits; if real estate is contributed, the deed must be granted by public instrument before a Notaría and recorded in the property registry.
required_dossiers: Draft by-laws (estatutos)
Homonimy certificate issued by RUES
Identification and, if resident, tax data of each shareholder
Notarial signature certificate or apostilled power of attorney for foreign shareholders
Valuation report for any in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective clauses may be cured by executing a corrective amendment before registration; if the deed has already been filed, the correction is made through a reform act protocolized before a notary and subsequently registered in the Mercantile Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration with the Chamber of Commerce and RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Bogotá or corresponding municipal Chamber), physical office or RUES remote filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Documento Privado de Constitución together with the single registration forms (Formulario Único de Registro) through RUES. Pay the registration tariff and applicable stamp taxes. Upon approval, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and assigns the matrícula mercantil; the company acquires legal personality on the registration date. Simultaneously request certification of the corporate books, including the share subscription ledger.
required_dossiers: Executed Documento Privado de Constitución
Homonimy certificate
Pre-RUT and single registration forms (RUES)
Bank receipt evidencing deposit of paid-in cash capital, if applicable
Identification documents of the legal representative and alternate officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber returns the file marked 'Inadmisión', the applicant must cure all cited defects within thirty (30) calendar days under Decreto 019 de 2012; if the term lapses, the filing is archived and a new application with corrected documents and fresh tariff must be submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN Tax Registration — NIT, RUT and Electronic Invoicing Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), www.dian.gov.co, coordinated electronically through RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Chamber registration, the pre-RUT data is transmitted to DIAN. Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) by confirming taxpayer type (S.A.S.), main economic activity (CIIU 3240), operational address and tax regimen (IVA responsible for manufacturing). Obtain the NIT and process the digital signature to activate electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) within the deadlines applicable to VAT registrants.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by the Chamber
Pre-RUT with the pre-assigned NIT
Proof of the operational address (public utility bill or lease agreement)
Identification document of the legal representative
Valid e-mail address for DIAN service of notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN challenges the RUT data, the taxpayer must file a corrective RUT ('Actualización RUT') through the electronic portal; discrepancies in economic activity codes are corrected spontaneously without sanction if submitted before any audit notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Industrial Registration and Physical/Environmental Clearance Intake
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) as territorial environmental authority; Cuerpo de Bomberos; Ministry of Labor social security administrators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register economic activity 3240 for the Impuesto de Industria y Comercio (ICA) before the municipal treasury and obtain the industrial taxpayer declaration. Obtain the certificate of land use (uso del suelo) from municipal planning, the fire-safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos), and file the applicable environmental instruments: fixed-source air emissions permit, wastewater discharge permit or sewer connection authorization, and hazardous-waste generator registration. For collectible-scale die-casting production below environmental licensing thresholds, sectoral environmental permits and registrations apply instead of a full environmental license.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT certificate
Matrícula mercantil certificate
Land-use certificate (certificado de uso del suelo)
Lease or ownership deed of the factory premises
Process description and emissions/waste inventory
Fire protection plan and equipment list
SG-SST preliminary program and ARL affiliation receipt
Wastewater characterization report or sewer service contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal treasury, CAR or Bomberos issues a formal requerimiento, the company must respond in writing within the stated notice term, generally thirty (30) calendar days; environmental permits not resolved within statutory periods may trigger 'silencio administrativo positivo' where the law so provides, and any denial may be appealed through reconsideration and the hierarchical appeal to the environmental authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – main portal www.dian.gov.co; electronic services via MUISCA and the Facturación Electrónica portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S., the process is: (i) register the company deed with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio); (ii) obtain the statutory NIT by completing the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) with DIAN (online or in person); (iii) activate the fiscal electronic invoice authorization and, if required, obtain a digital signature certificate. For a non-resident entity without a local establishment, the foreign company must execute a power of attorney appointing a Colombian tax representative and register a NIT through DIAN (form/RUT) before performing any activity subject to VAT or generating Colombian-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (a Colombian S.A.S. is a resident corporation taxed on its worldwide income; no pass-through or transparent classification is permitted, regardless of foreign shareholding).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available. Elections permitted by law include: (a) voluntary election of the Simplified Taxation Regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación – SIMPLE) for eligible entities with gross income not exceeding 100,000 UVT; (b) election of inflationary tax adjustments for certain balance-sheet items; and (c) application, with DIAN authorization, of the optional fiscal consolidation framework for 100%-owned Colombian group entities. Hybrid mismatch disallowances are applied automatically under the BEPS Action 2 rules adopted by Law 2277 of 2022.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA) – Value-Added Tax (VAT) under Articles 420-511-1 of the Colombian Tax Statute.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for legal entities; an S.A.S. undertaking any taxable activity must register as an IVA responsible person through the RUT. Natural persons qualifying as 'pequeños comerciantes' may be excused from charging IVA if their prior-year gross income does not exceed 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 126.5 million for fiscal year 2023).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All registered businesses must issue electronic sales invoices (factura electrónica de venta). Invoices must be transmitted to DIAN in near-real-time using certified software providers, DIAN's free MUISCA tool, or the DIAN e-invoicing API (SOAP/REST) with X.509 digital certificates. DIAN validates each invoice before it acquires full tax effects; each invoice carries a unique electronic code (CUFE) and a QR matrix. Supplementary electronic support documents (documento soporte en adquisiciones) are required for payments to non-responsible suppliers under Resolution 165/2023.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods (including die-cast scale automotive replicas) are zero-rated under Article 481 E.T. when the goods are definitively exported under a customs export declaration (DEX), leave Colombian customs territory, and are disposed of outside the national customs area. Export-related services are also zero-rated if the recipient is a foreign entity and the benefit is realized exclusively outside Colombia. The exporter may recover input VAT through a saldo a favor by filing a VAT refund application with DIAN and providing evidence of shipment and foreign exchange settlement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX) filed with DIAN/MUISCA evidencing the physical exit of the goods from the Colombian customs territory
Bill of Lading (or air waybill/road cargo manifest) showing the exporter as the shipper and the foreign destination of the die-cast models
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) or bank-issued export collection statement proving repatriation of the export proceeds in foreign currency
Commercial electronic invoice (factura electrónica de exportación) and, where applicable, certificate of origin or inspection certificate for preferential tariff treatment or customs compliance
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-validates export claims against customs records, transport-operating invoices, and national bank/foreign-exchange databases. A false or unsupported export zero-rating claim leads to (i) reversal and refund clawback of any VAT credit or refund paid, (ii) default interest accruing from the date of the refund, (iii) an inaccuracy penalty (sanción por inexactitud) typically 100% of the unduly claimed balance and up to 200% for egregious misstatements, and (iv) criminal prosecution for tax fraud under Law 2277 of 2022 with prison terms of 4 to 9 years. The DIAN audit/limitation period is generally five years, extending to ten years where returns are fraudulent or not filed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Junta Directiva) as central bank and foreign exchange administration, operating under Decreto 1735 de 1993 and Resolución Externa No. 8 de 2021; prudential and banking conduct supervision vested in the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; exchange infraction enforcement delegated in coordination with the DIAN and the Superintendencia Financiera.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia applies a managed floating exchange rate regime; the peso (COP) is freely convertible for current account transactions (goods, services, profit remittances, royalties) subject to documentation and channeling through authorized foreign exchange intermediaries. Capital account operations are lawful but controlled: foreign direct investment into an S.A.S. must be registered with Banco de la República within 6 months of the first remittance, using the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales (Formulario 1); dividends and disposal proceeds may then be remitted without quantitative limits, subject to registration continuity, tax clearance, and channeling through a licensed intermediary. Practical hurdles for an ISIC 3240 exporter include documentary mismatches between treasury flows and the corporate books, the obligation to route foreign currency exclusively through the mercado cambiario, and a 7.5% dividend remittance withholding tax on foreign shareholders unless reduced under a tax treaty. No general convertibility quota exists for a manufacturing exporter with auditable invoices.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of goods must channel 100% of proceeds from definitive exports through the authorized foreign exchange market (licensed bank, compensation account, or an eligible cross-border settlement arrangement) within 6 calendar months counted from the date of the export customs declaration (DEX). There is no forced conversion ratio into pesos: the exporter may lawfully retain USD in a domestic foreign-currency account or an offshore compensation account, provided the funds are 'reintegrated' into the exchange market within the term. Documentation at bank collection must include the export declaration digest, transport documents, commercial invoice, and the bank remittance advice. Non-compliance triggers exchange infractions, monetary fines of up to 200% of the un-interned balance, and possible loss of cost deductibility for the underlying export transaction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account: COP current account, USD demand account, export reintegro platform
Operational Account: COP checking plus multi-currency treasury
Operational Account: COP and USD remittance account, e-commerce aggregator
Capital Escrow Account for shareholder contributions plus operational account
Operational Account with dedicated FX and forward desk
Operational Account and Trade Finance desk (commercial letters of credit)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: LOW as a primary treasury rail; LIMITED as an ancillary digital collection layer. Colombian law recognizes only locally licensed credit entities and SEDPEs (Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos under Law 1735 of 2014) as authorized payment intermediaries. Offshore EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer and Airwallex are not supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera and cannot hold domestic COP accounts or act as exchange intermediaries. PayPal Colombia S.A.S. may process retail card receipts, but PayPal is not an authorized channel for export reintegro; using it as the sole collection rail creates exchange control exposure. Feasibility blueprint: PayPal for micro retail transactions only, swept automatically to the authorized bank; all commercial settlements above USD 5,000 must move via SWIFT MT103 through a Colombian licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a foreign-owned S.A.S., the conservative and recommended rule is physical presence of at least one Colombian-domiciled legal representative or a locally empowered attorney-in-fact during the account opening interview. Foreign directors and shareholders may be excused from physical appearance where their appointment acts are notarized, apostilled and translated, and where a Colombian attorney-in-fact executes a formal power of attorney registered with the Cámara de Comercio. Since the post-2020 digital onboarding modernization, fully remote enrollment with biometric verification is permitted for local officers, but the final KYC interview with the compliance officer for a 100% non-resident owned entity is normally mandated in person in Colombia. Practical mandate: authenticate foreign unanimous shareholders' resolutions by apostille, appoint a local legal representative, and schedule the compliance interview at the chosen bank's Bogotá or Medellín main branch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner located outside Colombia with non-resident tax status, triggering corporate shell and conduit risk in Customer Due Diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Certificado de Cámara de Comercio evidencing the legal representative; notarized and apostilled shareholder ledger; UIAF Beneficial Owner Report; audited or accountant-certified opening balance sheet of the S.A.S.; bank and investment statements of the shareholder for the prior 12 months; sworn source-of-funds affidavit; corporate resolution specifying the industrial purpose under ISIC 3240.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid ramp-up of die-cast collectibles export volumes, flagged as trade-based money laundering or informal value transfer pattern due to e-commerce PayPal flows and low-value consumer credits.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Distribution and licensing contracts with recognized collectible brands; marketplaces' settlement statements; PayPal-to-bank reconciliation ledger; export declarations (DEX), bills of lading, packing lists and customs certificates; DIAN RUT showing ISIC 3240; inventory and production machinery records; documented treasury policy capping PayPal settlement at USD 2,000 per consignment and mandating MT103 for all trade invoices above USD 5,000.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound equity injection structured as a personal-to-business SWIFT or intra-group loan without preceding foreign investment registration, creating exchange infraction risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT instruction letter signed by the shareholder and the S.A.S. specifying 'equity subscription' purpose; Banco de la República investment registration number; notarized board resolution authorizing the share issuance; public deed or private instrument evidencing quota payment; local independent accountant confirmation; traceability statement matching the remitting entity with the UBO and the investment registration certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Royalty outflow to foreign licensors of automotive brand trademarks used on 1:18 scale replicas, flagged for withholding tax evasion or IP-based money laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid licensing or technical assistance agreements; trademark registrations or coexistence letters from the licensor; DIAN service import declaration; RUT evidencing the S.A.S. commercial purpose; tax withholding certificates or applicable double tax treaty relief application; payment docket enclosing the license, invoice, withholding computation and proof of registration with the DIAN.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound raw material payments to suppliers in higher-risk or FATF grey-list jurisdictions for zinc alloy and mold procurement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Know-Your-Supplier file with supplier incorporation certificates, UBO attestations, tax identifiers and sanctions screening; Incoterms 2020 contract with precise zinc alloy grade, unit price and quantity; pre-shipment inspection certificates; bills of lading anchored to the invoice amounts; customs import declarations; advance payment indemnity letters where partial pre-funding is commercially required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between beneficiary names on digital payment receipts and the corporate trade invoice, causing automated AML alerts on intermingled receivables.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written treasury policy prohibiting settlement through non-identified payment instruments above USD 5,000; merchant settlement sweep documentation from PayPal and other processors into the Bancolombia USD account; monthly reconciliation file with gross amounts, chargebacks and net proceeds; annual external accountant's report linking e-commerce settlements to export declarations; bank confirmation that the aggregated digital receipts are treated as incidental and reclassified into the foreign exchange regime.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sequence: (1) register the foreign direct investment with Banco de la República's Registro de Inversiones Internacionales using Formulario 1 and the cambiario concept code for 'inversión directa en Colombia'; (2) remit USD by SWIFT MT103 through the shareholder's own account with a clear narrative referencing the registration number, the corporate document number and the wording 'shareholder equity subscription'; (3) present to the Colombian bank the notarized board/partner resolutions, the current Cámara de Comercio certificate and the accounting receipt for the capital quota; (4) instruct the local authorized intermediary to execute the USD-to-COP conversion at the TRM rate and credit the operational COP account, or alternatively credit the USD account and enter the position in the monthly FX declaration; (5) retain the Declaración de Cambio evidencing that the transaction is classified as registered foreign direct investment. The bank's underwriting will additionally require source-of-funds documentation for the remitting shareholder, and the registration certificate must be filed within six months of the first remittance to avoid reclassification as external debt.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing architecture: (a) standard supplier and operating disbursements below USD 100,000 execute by SWIFT MT103 through the correspondent banking chain, accompanied by DIAN electronic invoice references and, for import payments, a copy of the DIAN import declaration; (b) procurement above USD 100,000 uses a Commercial Letter of Credit opened by the S.A.S. at a Colombian bank, confirmed by the seller's bank and conditioned on full-set bills of lading, packing list, certificate of origin and metal-specification certificate; (c) export collections arrive as SWIFT MT103 USD credits into the S.A.S. foreign currency account, followed by a bank-executed 'reintegro' sale into the interbank market or retention as USD natural hedge; (d) PayPal and marketplace collections are swept weekly into the authorized COP account with reconciliation; (e) derivative collateral top-ups and premium settlements for FX hedging move through internal bank journal entries in COP between the treasury and derivative accounts. All import disbursements must observe Resolución 8 de 2021's payment calendar, generally allowing settlement up to six months after customs entry, with advance payments permitted only against a registered import obligation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP deliverable forward contracts (forwards sobre tasa de cambio) executed with a locally licensed bank, supported by documented export receivables or import payables, settled in COP by TRM differential.

USD/COP non-deliverable forwards (NDF) entered with offshore counterparties only where a local authorized intermediary acts as mirror or back-to-back hedge, underlying trade exposure is evidenced, and the transaction is included in the quarterly foreign exchange declaration.
FX swaps and cross-currency swaps matching USD export inflows against COP operating liabilities, executed under ISDA or local master agreements with the treasury desk of a supervised bank.
USD/COP European-style currency options used for hedging, not for speculative positions, with premiums settled through the local banking channel.

Natural hedge via multi-currency treasury: retention of USD export proceeds in local foreign currency accounts, scheduled monthly conversion to COP, and alignment of import payables with export receipts to reduce spot-market volatility exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Mercantile Registration Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil) with attached annual financial statements (Estados Financieros certificados y dictaminados, when applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Chamber of Commerce of the registered corporate seat)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year following the entity's registration anniversary; covers the preceding fiscal year for December 31 year-end entities (no statutory extension)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers default interest on the official fee, administrative fines up to 17 SMMLV (approximately USD 4,600 in 2025), and after one year of non-renewal administrative cancellation of the mercantile registration (cancelación de la matrícula mercantil), stripping the S.A.S. of legal capacity to execute contracts, operate bank accounts, or receive wire/PayPal collections; directors may incur personal liability for continuing operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual income tax and complementary return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios, Formulario 110)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between mid-August and mid-September of the following taxable year, scheduled by the last two digits of the NIT per the annual DIAN filing resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% per month or fraction on tax due, capped at 100% of the assessed tax, plus monthly default interest; omission of income or assets attracts penalties from 20% to 160% of the omitted value, with criminal referral for fraudulent returns under Estatuto Tributario Arts. 641 and 701-707.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual municipal Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA) return for manufacturing and sales of die-cast scale models
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal treasury of the principal place of business (e.g., Tesorería Distrital de Bogotá, Cartagena, or municipal finance secretariat)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during April per the applicable municipal ordinance, computed on prior-year gross operating revenue from manufacturing and sales activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or under-declaration attracts municipal fines, official aforo assessment based on presumed revenue, default interest, and compulsory collection (jurisdicción coactiva) including embargo of bank accounts and accounts receivable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO registry confirmation (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (RUB electronic filing module connected to the RUT platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 of the year following the reporting period; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be updated within 30 calendar days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or an inaccurate confirmation carries fines up to 15 SMMLV per violation under DIAN Resolution 000164 de 2021, as amended by Resolution 006 de 2022; the RUT and taxpayer status may be suspended until compliance, impeding foreign remittances via SWIFT wire or PayPal and freezing bank account maintenance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Transfer pricing annual information return and supporting documentation (Informe de Precios de Transferencia) - applicable only when statutory thresholds are exceeded
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (electronic filing of Form 120/121 with supporting studies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the annual income tax return (mid-August to mid-September of the following year) for the preceding year's comparable transactions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% per month of delay on any transfer pricing adjustment, capped at 100%; missing supporting studies carry independent fines ranging from 1% to 30% of transaction value under Estatuto Tributario Art. 260-11, and DIAN may recharacterize related-party pricing.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is mandatory for a Colombian S.A.S. when total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approximately USD 1.4 million in 2025) or gross annual income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (approximately USD 0.9 million in 2025) per Article 44 of Ley 1258 de 2008; appointment is also required when the Superintendencia de Sociedades exercises surveillance over the entity or when consolidated financial statements must be prepared. Below these thresholds, the shareholders must sign a joint responsibility declaration attached to the annual financial statements, confirming that no Revisor Fiscal is legally required.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian accounting standards adopt International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS/NIIF) through Decreto Único Reglamentario 2420 de 2015: Grupo 1 applies full IFRS for larger entities, Grupo 2 applies IFRS for SMEs for entities with gross assets below 35,000 SMMLV and fewer than 500 employees, and Grupo 3 applies a simplified cash-based framework only for micro-businesses; a die-cast scale-model manufacturer with physical inventories and international sales normally files under Grupo 1 or Grupo 2. Books, accounting records and supporting documents must be preserved for a minimum of ten (10) years from the date of the last entry under Código de Comercio Article 63 and DIAN documentation rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under DIAN Resolution 000164 de 2021, as modified by Resolution 006 de 2022, the S.A.S. must confirm its Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales annually before March 31, identifying every ultimate beneficial owner holding directly or indirectly 5% or more of the shares, voting rights, or control; any share transfer or change in ownership structure during the year must be updated within 30 calendar days. The annual confirmation must document the chain of shareholding transfers, certify the current UBO details on the RUB/RUT portal, and be executed by the legal representative under oath of accuracy.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Minute Book of Board of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Individual Transfer Record (Libro de Registro de Transferencia de Acciones)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - 1,200 per year (typical market range for Colombian registered office or registered agent services, including corporate address, mail forwarding, and statutory representation support)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 7,500 per year (typical certified audit or Revisor Fiscal fee for a mid-sized S.A.S. die-casting manufacturer with inventory, fixed assets, and international sales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for tax year 2024 (30% corporate rate plus 5% surtax for surviving entity regimes; standard Colombia general rate 35%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday applicable to zinc alloy die-casting manufacturing. Preferential deductions available under Article 158-3 ET: 40% additional deduction for new real productive fixed assets, 150% deduction on qualifying technical development and innovation expenditures, and 125% deduction on certain employment-related expenses. These may reduce the effective tax rate below the nominal 35% for qualifying companies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 – Declaración de Renta y Complementario, filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co) using the entity NIT and DIAN electronic credentials
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; Colombian income tax period is the calendar year (1 January – 31 December), with no elective fiscal year-end for tax purposes
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The filing deadline is set annually by DIAN Resolution according to the last two digits of the NIT. For legal entities, the deadline typically falls between 9 and 25 April of the following calendar year. The tax must be paid by the same deadline; individuals and non-residents not filing through Form 210 are governed by separate schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number of the S.A.S. entity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The NIT of the Colombian S.A.S. is mandatory; a non-resident shareholder's foreign tax ID or home-country NIT is not accepted in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered company name as recorded with the Chamber of Commerce
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; the legal name must match the S.A.S. registry documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Primary economic activity code; ISIC Rev. 4 / CIIU code 3240 (manufacture of games and toys, including die-cast scale models)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; the Colombian entity must select the local CIIU code representing the die-casting manufacturing operation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenue from the sale of die-cast automotive replicas and tampo-printing services, including cross-border B2B and B2C sales, freight reimbursement, and export sales
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not report the S.A.S. revenue in this box; revenue is attributed to the Colombian entity. If a foreign shareholder creates a permanent establishment in Colombia through the activity, separate PE reporting rules apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Documented costs of zinc alloy raw materials, die-casting molds, packaging, direct labor, and factory overhead
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; costs must be supported by invoices from Colombian or foreign suppliers complying with transfer-pricing rules for related-party purchases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses, depreciation, amortization, and allowable statutory deductions such as the 40% productive-fixed-asset deduction
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; payments to non-residents for royalties, interest, technical services, or other cross-border expenses must be deductibly supported and subjected to applicable withholding tax and transfer-pricing analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after all deductions, exemptions, and tax-loss offsets
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; if the Colombian S.A.S. has a PE or a Colombian branch owned by a foreign company, the taxable base must be computed under Article 24 ET norms.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Result of applying the 35% corporate income tax rate to the taxable income, plus any additional equity or dividend taxes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; withholding on future shareholder dividends is handled separately by the S.A.S. as withholding agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for prepaid corporate income tax (self-withholdings, prepayments, and the income-tax advance for the following year)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; non-resident shareholders do not modify the entity's prepayment credits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 62 – Saldo a pagar / saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable after credits or net refund balance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A; amounts due must be paid via DIAN tax collection mechanisms regardless of the shareholder's residence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty under Article 641 ET: 5% of the income tax due for each month or fraction of delay, subject to a maximum of 100% of the tax due; if no tax is due, the penalty is the greater of 1% of gross equity or 1% of gross income, subject to a minimum of 9 UVT and maximum of 1,000 UVT. Late payment accrues daily moratory interest under Article 634 ET. Inaccurate returns, including fraud, trigger an understatement penalty under Article 647 ET of 200% of the difference between the declared tax and the true tax liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding tax on dividend distributions and profit-sharing to non-resident shareholders (Article 408 ET), applied after the Colombian S.A.S. has paid corporate income tax on the profits. The combined effective burden on distributed profits is approximately 41.5% (35% corporate tax plus 10% withholding on the after-tax dividend).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced withholding rate under a Colombia double taxation agreement (DTA), the non-resident beneficial owner must deliver to the Colombian S.A.S. withholding agent: (i) a valid certificate of tax residence for the tax year of the dividend payment issued by the competent tax authority of the treaty jurisdiction, (ii) a declaration of beneficial ownership, and (iii) if required by DIAN, a Spanish translation and apostille/legalization. The certificate must be held by the withholding agent and exhibited upon DIAN request; no advance DIAN administrative approval is required for most treaties. Treaty benefits are denied where the structure lacks economic substance or the shareholder is a conduit under the principal-purpose test.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rates under Article 408 ET: interest paid to foreign lenders or bondholders is subject to 15% withholding (5% for qualifying external loans from foreign financial institutions, government agencies, or multilaterals); royalties for use of IP, know-how, trademarks, and similar intangibles are subject to 15% withholding. Treaties generally reduce these rates: interest and royalties are commonly limited to 10% (e.g., Spain, Chile, Mexico, South Korea); certain treaties provide 0% withholding on interest paid to government entities, central banks, or qualifying financial institutions. The S.A.S. must obtain updated TRC for each receivable before applying reduced treaty rates.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File, Master File, and transfer-pricing informative return apply to taxpayers that (i) carry out transactions with foreign related parties or persons in jurisdictions classified as tax havens and (ii) have gross equity or gross income exceeding 100,000 UVT in the prior tax year. For tax year 2024, 100,000 UVT equals COP 4,706,500,000 (using 2024 UVT of COP 47,065). Entities below this threshold must still benchmark transactions and may be audited if cross-border related-party pricing is not at arm's length. Country-by-Country Report obligations apply separately to multinational groups with consolidated revenue exceeding approximately COP 200 billion.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP – Comparable Uncontrolled Price (Precio Comparable No Controlado)
Transactional Net Margin Method – TNMM (Margen Neto Transaccional)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply the Caribbean-style Economic Substance Regulations to domestic S.A.S. entities. However, DIAN applies general anti-avoidance rules (Article 658-2 ET), the substance-over-form doctrine, CFC rules, and Article 260-1 ET reallocation powers. The die-casting S.A.S. must demonstrate actual business substance through physical factory premises, employees, die-casting machinery, operating expenses, inventory movement, and board decisions. If the entity is a mere conduit or shell, DIAN may disregard the separate legal personality, reallocate profits to the real economic owner, impose the 200% understatement penalty, and deny treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Revenue Omission or False Deductions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting cross-border and domestic sales of die-cast automotive replicas from the Formulario 210, fabricating purchases from non-existent suppliers, or inflating raw material and labor costs to reduce taxable income below the 35% corporate rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under Article 434A of Law 599 of 2000: imprisonment of four to nine years and a fine equal to at least 200% of the evaded tax. Administratively, DIAN may impose a 200% understatement penalty under Article 647 ET plus moratory interest and adjusted values.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives, and shareholders who knowingly sign or cause false returns are criminally liable. Under Articles 794 and 823 ET, they are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt, penalties, and interest; travel bans, asset embargoes, and disqualification from managing companies may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Economic Substance Abuse of the S.A.S.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the S.A.S. as a letterbox company with no physical factory, employees, tooling, warehouse, or business transactions while attributing the real die-casting business to a foreign related entity or offshore principal in a tax haven.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the S.A.S. corporate form under Article 658-2 ET, reallocate profits to the foreign shareholder, treat profits as a Colombian permanent establishment, and assess a 200% penalty on the adjusted tax plus moratory interest. The director/shareholder may also be denied the benefit of limited liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. law), the corporate veil may be pierced when the S.A.S. is used for fraud or tax evasion. Directors who execute shamming transactions are personally liable to the tax authority and to creditors for the entire adjusted tax, penalties, and non-penalty obligations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large, suspicious wire transfers or PayPal settlements into the corporate bank account without performing know-your-customer verification, failing to identify beneficial owners, using unlicensed payment intermediaries, or deliberately structuring transactions to avoid Colombia's AML reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offense under Article 323 of Law 599 of 2000: imprisonment of ten to twenty years and fines up to 50,000 current monthly minimum wages. Administrative penalties, asset freezing, and closure of bank accounts may be imposed by the Financial Information and Analysis Unit (UIAF) and Superintendencia de Sociedades.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the S.A.S.'s legal representative are personally exposed to criminal prosecution if they knowingly participate in laundering proceeds from die-cast collectibles transactions. International travel bans, extradition requests, and disqualification from corporate office are applicable; the US Patriot Act counterpart and inter-American cooperation may also trigger asset forfeiture.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Invoicing and False Accounting Records
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or using false invoices (facturas falsas) for raw materials, tooling, or tampo-printing supplies, maintaining two sets of inventory books, or recording fictitious cross-border purchases to fraudulently obtain deductions and VAT input credits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may cancel the S.A.S.'s invoicing authorization, impose a penalty under Article 652 ET up to 10,000 UVT per infringement, and reject all associated deductions. Falsifying private documents under Article 285 of Law 599 of 2000 carries imprisonment of 32 to 72 months. Tax fraud penalties of up to 200% of the inaccuracy are additionally imposed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify or authorize false financial statements are criminally liable for falsification of private documents. Article 42 of Law 1258 of 2008 permits creditors and DIAN to pierce the veil, making directors jointly liable for the entire tax adjustment, fines, and civil damages arising from the false invoices.
